messages:
ava: Quick heads-up: we observed short requests getting absorbed into long coalesce windows when older agents omit the new handshake header. P99 latency regressed in a few tenants.
sam: Can you share a tiny repro?
ava: Tenant B, short prompt, agent without `X-Coalesce-Handshake`. Server treats deadline_hint as missing and uses default 100ms window -> p99 spikes.
zhen: I reproduced in staging. Missing handshake also means we skip KV reservation and later the scheduler assumes no headroom which can cascade under load.
ravi: Two pragmatic mitigations: (A) synthesize a conservative deadline_hint at gateway when header absent, (B) mark synthesized requests as `kv_reserved=false` to avoid overcommit.
marta: For synth value, use min(tenant_min_slo, 75ms). That protects latency without being overly aggressive on throughput.
sam: We'll need a normalization middleware at front-door that emits canonical fields: `canonical_deadline_hint`, `kv_reserved`, `handshake_source`. Downstream reads canonical fields only.
zhen: Add telemetry: counters `enqueue.normalized`, `enqueue.synth_deadline`, `enqueue.kv_no_reserve`; histogram split by `handshake_source` for enqueue->start latency.
ava: Rollout plan: start as read-only (emit metrics) for 24h, if synthesized fraction >1% per tenant then enable synth path, and if >5% sustained for 30m auto-toggle microwindows (smaller coalesce) for 10m.m:typo: "marta:" should be unchanged.
marta: Also ensure we don't change required Enqueue proto fields; use optional headers only. Hosted agents cannot be forced to rebuild.
ravi: Tests: unit tests for normalizer logic; perf integ that simulates mixed agents (10% legacy) at 50k req/s to validate no KV headroom overcommit.
sam: Add config `compat.microwindow` gated off by default; auto-toggle hook to enable for specific tenants based on metrics.
zhen: infra-bot: CI `eng-runtime/compat-normalizer` queued (unit + smoke perf). :robot_face:
ava: I'll open PR for normalizer and telemetry, link it here when ready.
sam: I'll own microwindow flag + auto-toggle.
ravi: I'll add KV headroom tests and integ perf harness.
marta: I'll draft rollout playbook and alerting rules for synthesized fraction.
ava: Follow-up: include response header `X-Inference-Compat: synthesized_deadline` so customers can see when we synthesized.
sam: Long-term: keep normalize middleware even after agents adopt handshake; it acts as a single canonicalizer for future protocol evolution.
